configReload.text: Another device changed Obsidian's configuration (plugins, appearance or settings). Reload Obsidian to apply it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.addDeviceDesc: Show a QR code or a link to link another device.
settings.unlinkDesc: Stops sync and revokes this device on the server.
settings.unlinkText: Sync for this vault stops and this device is revoked on the server. The files on this device stay where they are.
settings.notActive: These settings will be used when sync is active.
settings.modeDesc: Modes only change when syncing happens, never what gets saved.
settings.wifiOnlyDesc: Files above the threshold wait for a Wi-Fi network.
settings.iosNote: On iPhone and iPad the network is always treated as metered: you will be asked to confirm.
settings.exclusionsDesc: One pattern per line, for example Archive/**
settings.alwaysExcluded: Always excluded: this plugin's data, window state (workspace), cache.
settings.configNote: Beta feature. If two devices change the same file, the last change to arrive wins; the other stays in the history and can be restored. Incoming changes to this folder are not applied right away: you will be offered to restart Obsidian.
settings.reloadToApply: Synced configuration changed: reload Obsidian to apply it.
settings.diagnosticsDesc: Copies a technical log to paste in a support request. It holds only event codes and times: no file names, paths or contents.

dev.linkTestHint: Scan the code with the phone camera, or run in a terminal: {command}

panel.title: Sync status
panel.confirmDeletionsText: {count} files disappeared from this device at once. If you deleted them, they will go to the trash on your other devices too; their versions stay on the server. If they disappeared by mistake (a disk not connected, a missing permission), cancel and check first.

conflict.summaryEdit: Edited here ({mine}) and on {device} ({incoming}). Both versions are saved.
conflict.summaryCreated: Two files with the same name created here ({mine}) and on {device} ({incoming}). Both are saved.
conflict.doneMine: You kept your version. The one from {device} stays in the history.
conflict.doneIncoming: You kept the version from {device}. Yours stays in the history.
conflict.doneBoth: You kept both: yours is saved as a separate file.
conflict.stale: A newer version arrived: check again before choosing.
conflict.gone: This conflict has already been resolved.
conflict.failed: Could not apply your choice. Try again.
conflict.unsavedMerge: Your merge was not saved: here it is, you can copy it.
conflict.elsewhere: Resolve this conflict from the device that has the other version, or from the web app. Both versions are safe.

bulk.title: Resolve all conflicts
bulk.failed: Could not resolve the conflicts. Try again.

pairing.alreadyLinked: This vault is already linked to a server. To link it another way, unlink it first in the settings.
pairing.codeIntro: A request will appear on the device that generated the code. Approve it only if you see this same code:
pairing.denied: Linking denied by the other device.
pairing.expired: Time is up: generate a new code.
pairing.alreadyClaimed: The link has already been used.
pairing.addIntro: Scan the code with the camera of the new device, where Obsidian and the plugin are already installed in an empty vault.
pairing.qrAlt: QR code to link a device
pairing.requestHint: Approve only if you see the same code on the new device. If it wasn't you, deny.
pairing.noticeRequest: A new device asks to link. Tap to answer.
pairing.noticeReused: The link was used by a second device and has been blocked.
pairing.requestGone: This request is no longer valid: it expired or was already answered.
pairing.answerFailed: Could not send the answer. Try again.
pairing.comingSoon: QR pairing is coming in a next version: for now connect this device with your username and password.

welcome.title: Welcome to {product}
welcome.intro: Link this vault to a server to sync it across your devices. No file is overwritten without asking you.
welcome.createDesc: Create the vault on the server from these files.
welcome.joinDesc: Sign in to the server with username and password.
welcome.linkTitle: I have a QR code or a link
welcome.linkDesc: Generate it on a device that is already linked and open it here.
welcome.linkHowMobile: Scan the QR code with the phone camera: Obsidian opens and linking starts by itself.
welcome.linkHowDesktop: Scan the QR code with a phone camera, or paste the link here.
welcome.linkInvalid: This is not a valid pairing link.

connect.insecure: Unencrypted connection: use this server only on a network you trust.
connect.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
connect.noVaults: No vaults on this server: use 'This is the first device'.
connect.reconcile: This vault already contains {count} files: I compare them with the ones on the server. Identical files stay as they are, different ones become conflicts to review. No file is overwritten.

errors.unreachable: Server unreachable: check the address and the connection.
errors.incompatible: Server version not compatible with this plugin: update the plugin or the server.
errors.insecure_on_mobile: On a phone an https:// address is required. For a home server you can use Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel or a reverse proxy with a certificate.
errors.totp_mandatory: Two-step verification is required for administrators: turn it on in the web app (Account), then try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts: wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.update_required: This plugin is too old for the server: update it, then try again.
errors.failed: The link could not be completed. Try again; if it happens again, copy the diagnostics from the settings.

transfer.keepWorking: You can keep working: new changes are added to the queue.
transfer.interrupted: Interrupted: resuming as soon as possible.
transfer.failed: The transfer stopped because of an error.
transfer.doneWaiting: {count} files wait (Wi-Fi, size or unreadable): see the sync status.

metered.title: Use the mobile network?
metered.text: Large attachments are set to wait for Wi-Fi, and this phone can't tell which network it is on. Use the current network for them now?
metered.dontAsk: Don't ask again until Obsidian restarts

forceSync.title: Force sync from this device
forceSync.text: The files on this device overwrite the same files on the devices you choose. Their different copies stay in the history; files only they have are kept. Each device realigns at its next connection.
forceSync.none: No other device is linked to this vault.
forceSync.sent: Forced sync requested: the chosen devices realign at their next connection.
forceSync.failed: The server could not be reached. Try again.
